context: Tests whether the agent produces the correct three-file output structure, buckets drugs into AVOID/CAUTION/STANDARD/INSUFFICIENT, includes the mandatory disclaimer, and generates a reproducibility record — all core skill outputs from the PharmGx Reporter.

checklist.name: report.md present
checklist.description: A file named report.md exists under the output directory

checklist.name: result.json present
checklist.description: A file named result.json exists under the output directory

checklist.name: reproducibility/commands.sh present
checklist.description: A file named commands.sh exists under output/reproducibility/ (the exact subdirectory path from the skill spec)

checklist.name: AVOID bucket
checklist.description: report.md contains a section or label using the word AVOID (upper-case) for drug recommendations

checklist.name: CAUTION bucket
checklist.description: report.md contains a section or label using the word CAUTION (upper-case) for drug recommendations

checklist.name: STANDARD bucket
checklist.description: report.md contains a section or label using the word STANDARD (upper-case) for drug recommendations

checklist.name: INSUFFICIENT/INDETERMINATE bucket
checklist.description: report.md contains a section or label for INSUFFICIENT or INDETERMINATE drugs

checklist.name: Gene profile table
checklist.description: report.md contains a table with at least the columns Gene, Diplotype, and Phenotype

checklist.name: Drug table present
checklist.description: report.md contains a table listing multiple drugs with their Gene and Status columns

checklist.name: Medical disclaimer
checklist.description: report.md contains text stating this is for research/educational purposes only and is NOT a diagnostic device

checklist.name: SHA-256 checksum
checklist.description: report.md contains a SHA-256 checksum of the input file

checklist.name: 12 genes covered
checklist.description: The gene profile table in report.md lists at least 10 of the 12 expected genes (CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, VKORC1, SLCO1B1, DPYD, TPMT, UGT1A1, CYP3A5, CYP2B6, NUDT15, CYP1A2)
